title: Career Development Centre (CDC)
content: The Career Development Centre (CDC) runs VIT-AP's placement and training activities, including a dedicated Placement and Training (PAT) programme for skill and aptitude enhancement, mock interviews, group discussion practice, and coding/aptitude preparation. CDC also manages Dream and Super Dream placement offer categories and coordinates internship opportunities. Contact: placement@vitap.ac.in or 0863-2370219 (Dr. Srinivasa Reddy Konda, Assistant Director). Aggregate placement statistics (numbers of offers, packages) are published on the CDC Statistics page but were not captured with specific figures here, so check that page directly for current numbers.
